findings.text: the two-arm table gives the 77283793bc arm "1906" sort_link calls, but arms2.log holds 1907 completed SORTLINK_END lines (call 0 through 1906) for that arm exactly as for be5ee98f7; the two columns are therefore counted differently and line 46 repeats the 1 907 / 1 906 pair.
